Interest truncated to whole cents instead of taken to the nearest cent in the schedule.
Zero rate not handled: the level payment divides by (1 - 1^-n) = 0 instead of the loan over the months.
Missing r > -1 check: a rate at or below -1 is accepted and returns a number instead of raising ValueError.
Zero rate allowed by the perpetuity guard: r = 0 passes the check and fails with ZeroDivisionError.
Hard-coded answer: level_payment_cents returns the seed-0 loan payment, 429672 cents, for every loan.
